definitions.explanation: Physical or emotional strength and intensity.
The force or speed gained by movement or progress.
The capacity to affect others or events.

examples.japanese: {勢|いきお}いよく⟦{走|はし}り{出|だ}した→走る：00519_hashiru⟧。
⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{勢|いきお}いよく⟦{流|なが}れている→流れる：01969_nagareru⟧。
examples.english: Water is flowing with great force.

examples.english: The wind was so strong that my umbrella almost broke.

examples.english: It picked up speed going down the hill.

examples.english: If you try to do everything alone, strain will inevitably build up.

notes:
{勢|いきお}い has a broad range of meanings centered on force, vigor, and momentum. It can function as both a noun and an adverb.

NOUN USES:
1. Physical force/vigor: ⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{勢|いきお}い (force of water)
2. Momentum/impetus: {勢|いきお}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}る→乗る：00511_noru⟧ (ride the momentum)
3. Influence/power: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{勢|いきお}い (a company's power)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {勢|いきお}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (to have vigor, energy)
- {勢|いきお}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}る→乗る：00511_noru⟧ (ride the momentum)
- {勢|いきお}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{増|ま}す→増す：02422_masu⟧ (gain momentum)
- {勢|いきお}い⟦{余|あま}って→余る：00001_amaru⟧ (carried away by momentum)
- {勢|いきお}い⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧ (vigorously, with force)

ADVERBIAL USE:
When used as an adverb, {勢|いきお}い means 'naturally' or 'inevitably' — something happens as a natural consequence.
- ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えると→増える：01183_fueru⟧、{勢|いきお}い⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦なくなる→無くなる：01101_nakunaru⟧ (when work increases, you inevitably run out of time)
